axes.ylabel: Net replacement (% of the previous year's stock per year)

texts: Net replacement (% of the previous year's stock per year)
note: Net replacement rate (demolition net of unconsented additions). Long run 1991–2023: 0.101% per year; 2018–23: 0.312% per year. Each step is one intercensal interval; the 2018–23 step is a single interval. Negative values mean the stock grew by more than consented new building, i.e. more dwellings appeared through conversions and unconsented additions than were demolished.
